title: The Frost Lemon Harvest
description: The winter harvest begins on the coldest morning, when the lemons turn to gold ice. The pickers wear thick mittens and gather them before the sun warms the terraces.
alt: Three people in winter clothes pick faceted yellow ice lemons on snowy terraces. A basket of lemons sits at their feet, with blue mountains in the distance.
pairing: An imagined winter harvest holiday × lemons made of golden ice
